title: Flipkart Internet’s sales surge 18 per cent, losses shrink as the e-commerce giant eyes a public listing
summary: Flipkart Internet achieved an 18% increase in revenue to Rs 1,45,880 crore in FY26. The company's net loss decreased by Rs 178 crore to Rs 8,468 crore during the same period. Gross margins expanded by 23% year-on-year, indicating improved unit economics for the company. Adjusted operating losses reduced by about Rs 1,600 crore, and the operating margin improved by 230 basis points.
